name: Eris Elenoare
original_name: エリス・エレノアール
source:
Likes: Gummies, stuffed animals, clothes with check patterns
Dislikes: Ghosts, bitter foods

Eris is the girl who claims to have summoned [url=/c39583]Yuuto[/url]. She is always very cheerful, hates to lose, and has a strong sense of responsibility and can't say no to others' requests. She is also somewhat shy, but due to her frank nature, she is unable to hide it properly. When she falls in love with, she single-handedly devotes herself to her object of affection.
